A debt free currency is a currency which has no government bonds attached to its creation. For example, if the Federal Government needs an extra $1 million then they would give $1 million in US Treasury Bonds to the Federal Reserve and in return recieve one million Federal Reserve notes. This ensures that for every dollar in circulation, there is one dollar worth of debt attached to it. Currently there is about $1.35 worth of debt for every dollar in circulation meaning that if we paid off the national debt there would be no money left and still debt left over.

This central banking scam has been going on for millenia in various forms. It's the oldest confidence trick in the book. Ceasar Augustus was the earliest known example of a leader who unchained his country from this burden. Adolf Hitler and the National Socialists did the same.
